claim_scope: Computer-assisted theorem: every two-hub tree whose two pendant-arm multisets have total weight at most 24 has a log-concave independence polynomial for every number of internal connector vertices.

theorem_vs_computation.algebraic_part: The connector formula, Fibonacci recurrence, and partial-synchronization induction cover every connector length.
theorem_vs_computation.exact_computational_part: The finite integer-partition enumeration verifies the two base polynomials and two base relations for every bounded pendant core.
theorem_vs_computation.not_claimed: No conclusion is made for pendant cores above the stated bound, for trees with three or more branch vertices, or for Erdos Problem 993 in full.
